_comment: Curated gap-fill list for the bdocodex supplemental source (npm run collect:bdocodex). Each entry is a recipe VERIFIED missing from bdolytics' Crafting Calculator. This list is a scope decision, not a technical limit: bdocodex category listings do render recipe links after JS load, so bulk harvesting would be technically possible - but per project anti-bulk policy only hand-verified missing recipes go here. Add entries as new gaps are confirmed (name + numeric bdocodex ID from the page URL /us/recipe/<id>/).

recipes.name: Sweet Honey Wine
recipes.note: Confirmed absent from all 4 bdolytics Cooking pages (152 recipes). Ingredients: Top-quality Cooking Honey x2, Full-bodied Makgeolli x4, Sugar x10, Apple x2.
